pages.title: Greater Than
pages.text:
double a, double b -> Greater Than -> boolean.
Consumes two numbers from stack top and compares them, pushes result back

Returns true if b > a, false otherwise

Example: Push 1, then push 2. Stack pops 2 as a, then pops 1 as b, outputs boolean for 1 > 2

pages.title: Less Than
pages.text:
double a, double b -> Less Than -> boolean.
Consumes two numbers from stack top and compares them, pushes result back

Returns true if b < a, false otherwise

Example: Push 1, then push 2. Stack pops 2 as a, then pops 1 as b, outputs boolean for 1 < 2
